rule: maximise share of readings decided automatically (coverage) while the safety limits (invalid precision >= 0.99, <= 5% of faults (and <= 10% of any single fault type) slipping through as VALID, <= 3% of real events auto-rejected) are met on validation; candidates within 0.003 coverage are separated by PR-AUC (how well faults are ranked above good readings), then lowest latency
